PDCCH/PDSCH is not PRS aware, i.e. PDCCH/PDSCH rate-matching is not affected by PRS.
If PRS collides with PDCCH/PDSCH then PRS has higher priority and PDCCH/PDSCH will be punctured, i.e. PDCCH/PDSCH
transmission will probably be corrupted.
In general, PRS overlap with other signals/channels does not really make sense because collision with other RS or DMRS is
very likely ... unless e.g. spatial separation on different beams is wanted.

Sidelink identity definition is different.
It spans less RBs in frequency, only 11 RBs or 132REs .
It spans more OFDM symbols in time, i.e. almost a full slot.
S-PSS and S-SSS are repeated.
PSBCH is larger and requires more REs.

answer.text: The RAW passages do not define “packet error rate”; they only state that packet error rate (PER) has measurement settings and results included in WLAN signaling [2]. Product-related decisions tied to such measurements in the Rohde & Schwarz context include choosing the required operation mode because available measurements differ by mode, selecting the needed measurement on the instrument [5], and choosing/order­ing appropriate product options or solutions via Rohde & Schwarz product information or experts [4].
